items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: And I gave him one or two lessons with Nolly Daniel.

ctx.x: But they just had the bass violins. They had all the time, they just had the bass violins.

And so, Mobiliar's had a good many musicians. Now we got, we got a couple of boys from Mobiliar. One's over in England somewhere, he was a little fella. He picked up around here and was in the Lipskins band. Well, he practically wasn't exactly in the band, he'd just go along with them and play a little at the time. And one of the fellas was taking interest in him and started teaching him the music well. He was playful and he didn't seem to take to it too much. One of them was playing corinette and one of them was…
Is folks still here, some of them, are they? Huh?
